<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_BankingSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BankingSystem" name="Banking system credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreditScoringRequested" name="Credit-scoring requested"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelayNotice" name="Receive delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentImmediateResult" name="Present scoring result to clerk at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display delay message to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" name="Display scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateResultPresented" name="Immediate result presented"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level2ResultDisplayed" name="Level 2 result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreditScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_PresentImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_PresentImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" targetRef="EndEvent_Level2ResultDisplayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Is the scoring determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateScoringComplete" name="Immediate scoring result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level2ScoringComplete" name="Level 2 scoring result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateScoringComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="EndEvent_Level2ScoringComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
